summary: LUX-150 acceptance was recorded before a public ComponentDefinition source-compatibility regression was surfaced.
expected: Existing SDK 0.4 source may continue to annotate a code component as ComponentDefinition and access or call definition.create without rewriting the source.
actual: Submitted df472683234847f426f594ccdd414889c2783c61 and landed 72bdcfa9f53c8335c59fa3435b3ff77648375602 redefine ComponentDefinition as CodeComponentDefinition | GraphComponentDefinition. The strict compiler rejects the previously valid unguarded .create access; the changed regression test added a kind guard and therefore did not prove unchanged-source compatibility. The independent acceptance had already moved LUX-150 to done revision 5 before this evidence arrived. Conductor 0.2.0-dev rejects a later ticket reject on a done ticket with INVALID_STATE: ticket must be in review; no reopen command is documented.
correction: Treat the revision-5 acceptance as superseded for release. Preserve ComponentDefinition<C,I,O> as the compatibility alias to CodeComponentDefinition<C,I,O>, add a separately named AnyComponentDefinition union for graph containers and defineComponent internals, restore the exact old unguarded .create compile/link regression, rerun combined checks, then create and validate a linked bug-fix ticket because the accepted ticket cannot be reopened through the installed CLI.
evidence: Reviewer context codex:/root/review_component_design:component-definition-compatibility-correction-20260916. Integration record: artifacts/feedback-01a0a7bb/component-audio-integration.md. Superseded acceptance event: LUX-150 revision 5, event 765ddd04-359c-4369-a5dd-504f02852fca. Failed correction command returned INVALID_STATE with message `ticket must be in review`. LUX-151 behavior remains independently reviewed, but the bundled release is held until the linked compatibility fix lands and is reviewed.
